name: JA Kinetic
description: Observability and developer-tool system: near-neutral off-white or near-black grounds under flat bordered cards, one saturated accent per colourway (olive and lime, indigo, or cyan) selected by a data-style attribute, Space Grotesk display at weight 700 with negative tracking over IBM Plex Sans body, JetBrains Mono for uppercase eyebrows, chips, stats and code panels, an eight-pixel spacing unit, an 8 / 12 / 16px radius ladder, almost no shadow, and a faint 30px line grid behind the hero and the page mastheads.

source.origin: Read from the ja_kinetic Joomla template source (JoomlArt, T4 framework, version 1.0.0): the unprefixed token set on :root and html[data-style="terminal"] in scss/_kinetic.scss, its dark remap in scss/darkmode.scss and css/darkmode.css, the chrome set in scss/_kinetic-chrome.scss, and the 20 ACM blocks in acm/*/, cross-checked against the template's own docs/design-system.md
